Hi Maya — thanks for the heads up and the log snippet, that helps. We can support a temporary windowed uplift — below is a quick sketch of an operational and commercial option that we can spin up within a few hours once you confirm.

Proposal (72-hour window, 3x headroom):
- Capacity: 3x your current committed throughput cap, soft-throttle above 3x with graceful 429s so you can shape traffic.
- Rate limit: Increase per-second token limit on your route from 1200 t/s to 3600 t/s during the window.
- Billing: prorated usage at your current PAYG unit rates for the uplift window.
- Conversion incentive: 20% one-time usage credit applied if you convert this uplift to a 6-month Dedicated commit within 30 days.
- Refunds/credits: No automatic refunds for traffic above 3x; if we jointly agree the spike was caused by platform misconfiguration we'll discuss good-faith credits.

Operational notes: we recommend pinning to the 8-bit quantized variant of the model for the test to reduce per-token cost, and enable prefix caching for any repeated prompts. Karthik, can you confirm there are no model-compat issues with their prompt patterns?

I've attached a short quote + addendum draft for legal (tmp_uplift_quote.pdf, BrightCart_Addendum_v1.docx). If you confirm, we'll provision and send a DocuSign link for a short addendum.

If you want a tighter commercial offer I can ask for an approval from my manager for a larger conversion credit — looping Ben and Laura now for quick sign-off.

Best,
